text:
Ellie: quick sync ":wave:" — setting up a small pilot: "playground" onboarding for 5 SI partners to test our field kit + marketplace flow. Goals: verify pack BOM, badge flow, and feature-flag gating before larger rollout. Need signoffs by Mon.

Harsh: what's the exact pack BOM? Also any ECCN/export notes for APAC?

Ellie: minimal pack: RDW-PLAY-TRAY, signed USB image, quickstart card, return label, IEC adapters per region. Intl manifests must include ECCN 5D002 where applicable.

Nora: For badges: issue provisional digital badge on quiz pass, final badge after screencast verification or kit scan. Add QR+verify link. Retention: verification records 90 days unless partner requests different.

Ken: Logistics: prefer DHL APAC, UPS EU/NA for tracking. Need PO + cost center before we print labels. If partners need custom crates, allow 3 business days lead.

marketing: creative wants one-liners + logo consent 5 business days before any mention. If partners require embargo review, loop legal early.

Ellie: proposed cert windows: region-aligned 48hr windows; offer optional live proctor slots. Also run a 45min mentor dry-run (recorded) before packs ship.

Harsh: I'll prepare the `lab-provision` snippet for the quickstart card and record a 15min bringup video. Snippet:
```bash
# mentor quickstart
redwoodctl lab provision --image si-playground-2026 --role mentor --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
redwoodctl lab status --wait
```

logistics-bot: [automation] play-pack job queued (job_id=play-356789) — est pickup: 2026-09-20.

Nora: scoring rubric: bringup 40, demo walkthrough 30, quiz 30. Passing >=75%. Auto-grade MC, manual review for config write. Allow one resubmit within 7 days.

Ken: PO suggestion: RDW-SI-PLAY-3567. I'll confirm cost center by EOD and post the procurement ticket. Add "Fragile - electronics" and "Return to Redwood" to boxes.

Ellie: action items:
- Harsh: video + `lab-provision` snippet (due Sep 15).
- Ken: confirm PO & carrier (due Sep 14).
- Nora: finalize rubric + verification URL (due Sep 13).
- Marketing: collect blurbs + logo consent (due Sep 13).

Ellie: flagging one constraint: a partner in LATAM needs 110V adapter — please list exceptions here. Will post final checklist after items close. :white_check_mark:
